s8.headline: AI-native ≠ fundamentals-free.

columns.chip: Fundamentals are how you catch what the agent got wrong.

s8.quote: We need to teach abstraction, decomposition, and specification not just as pre-coding steps, but as the new coding.
s8.quoteBy: Thomas Dohmke, then CEO of GitHub, with Eirini Kalliamvakou · Aug 2025

s10.headline: Learn with AI — and without it.
s10.trial: Anthropic randomised trial · 29 Jan 2026 · 52 mostly junior engineers
s10.patterns: Asked AI to explain: ≥65% · Delegated to AI: <40%
order: Use AI to explain, compare and critique
Delegate to agents — once you can verify the result
s10.orderCaption: Agentic coding is a skill too — learn it after you've written code yourself.
s10.dora: DORA, Mar 2026 — the expertise paradox: lower barriers risk “bypassing the ‘productive struggle’ necessary for deep technical expertise.”
s10.gregg: “That struggle is the part where the learning happens.” — Chris Gregg, Stanford
s10.last: Use AI to accelerate learning — not to skip learning.
